arguments.message:
Hi there,

If the invoice you received by email doesn’t match the amounts or due date shown in Settings → Billing → Invoices inside your account, it should be treated as unverified. Do not click any links, reply, or make a payment until you’ve confirmed it.

Please compare the email details with the billing information in your account. If there’s a mismatch, forward the email to us (you can use the “Forward to support” option) so we can check it against your real billing record and let you know whether it’s genuine or fraudulent.

Thanks,
Meridian Support
